subject: Post-call recap: exec sponsorship & procurement next steps (AuroraMed)
message_1_subject: Post-call recap: exec sponsorship & procurement next steps (AuroraMed)
message_1_body:
Hi Sophie / Kevin,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the candid conversation and the clear signals around where Aurora wants to move on generative features. Below is a short recap, business outcomes we can help deliver, and suggested next steps so procurement and leadership know what to expect.

Quick recap / pain points:
- Latency: your patient triage assistant is seeing 90th-percentile token latencies ~500ms under peak which is impacting conversion for the mobile flow.
- Cost predictability: high and variable per-token costs across burst windows make it hard to forecast monthly spend for pilots.
- Compliance & data residency: PHI requirements and a pending security review from your CISO mean private deployment or strong controls are required.

Goals we discussed:
- Bring 90th latency down to <200ms for the mobile patient assistant (target within pilot).
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~40% via batching/quant profiles without degrading quality.
- Have an approved procurement path for a 6-month pilot with private deployment option and SLA.

Business outcomes (what Aurora gets):
- Improved conversion on triage flows => estimated revenue uplift from faster interactions.
- Predictable unit economics and a recommended configuration to keep costs flat even in bursts.
- Audit-ready artifacts (SOC2 summary, data retention policy) to clear CISO review.

Procurement / escalation items we agreed to surface:
1) Executive sponsor alignment (needed for pilot approvals) — Sophie, you indicated VP/GM buy-in will be required.
2) CISO review — Thomas will need SOC2 evidence + an hour session with our security team.
3) Vendor onboarding / procurement — Kevin, you'll lead the PO/vendor paperwork; typical path we see is: NDA (if needed) -> vendor questionnaire -> PO/contract -> onboarding.

Attachments: I attached a concise pricing estimate and a SOC2 summary that customers use for CISO reviews.

Suggested next steps (my proposed plan):
- Marissa (me) + Aditya to produce an exec one-pager and a cost estimate by Friday 6/26.
- Schedule a 45m security review with Thomas + our security lead (options: Tues 6/30 or Wed 7/1).
- Kevin to share procurement timeline / required docs by EOW so we can align contract terms.

If you want a short executive call (15-20m) with our Head of Sales (Aditya) to fast-track sponsorship, we can set that up early next week.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the one-pager and the cost attachment.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
